full.en: Vitamin C 500 mg, 30 capsules – food supplement. Vitamin C contributes to the normal functioning of the immune system and to normal collagen formation, which is important for skin health. Ingredients: vitamin C (ascorbic acid), rosehip fruit powder (Rosa canina), capsule: hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC). Using advice: take 1 capsule daily. Storage: store in a cool, dry place. Warnings: the recommended daily amount should not be exceeded. Food supplement is not a substitute for a balanced and varied diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of reach of children. The product is not suitable for pregnant or breastfeeding women.
